test: reproduce lazy binding forward reference runtime error (#1734)

When a `let rec` group contains a lazy binding (Case B: Pmakeblock with
all-function-or-const args) that is referenced by a sibling binding
using `update_dummy`, the lazy binding was emitted as a `const`
declaration after the `update_dummy` call that references it, causing
a temporal dead zone ReferenceError at runtime.

Strengthen the Case B guard in `compile_recursive_let` to check whether
any other binding in the same recursive group references this identifier.
When it does, fall through to Case D (dummy + update_dummy) so the
declaration is hoisted before any eager references.
